module-settings.academic-year-regular-explanation: These are the configurations that will apply to the regular academic year program. As soon as the summer configuration date begins, regular academic year program settings will stop automatically. If you select the same day and month for both cases, these options are the default ones.
module-settings.academic-year-summer-explanation: These are the configurations that will apply to the summer program. As soon as the regular academic year configuration date begins, summer program settings will stop automatically.
module-settings.settings-month-year: Select the month and day that these settings will apply to. The start hour will be based on UTC time.
module-settings.subtitle: Enable or disable the sections associated with this role.
module-settings.ai-tutor-settings-explanation: These settings control how the AI tutor answers student questions. Check the grades that should be answered by the RAG engine, which restricts responses to your approved academic content. Any grade left unchecked will use the generative engine instead. Changes are saved automatically.
module-settings.ai-tutor-rag-grades: Grades that use the RAG engine
module-settings.ai-quotas-settings-explanation: These settings limit how much AI resources each user may consume. Limits apply per user: a monthly limit of 50,000 tokens means every user gets 50,000 tokens each month.
module-settings.ai-quotas-enabled-explanation: While this is off, no limit is applied even if the resources below are configured.
module-settings.ai-quotas-ai-will-disable: All AI services will be turned off when you save.
module-settings.ai-quotas-ai-enabled-explanation: Master switch for AI generation. When off, all AI services will be blocked for every user, regardless of their remaining balance.
module-settings.ai-quotas-none-enforced: Quota control is on, but no resource has its limit enabled, so no global limit applies right now. Any exception configured below still applies to its target.
module-settings.ai-quotas-no-resources: There are no AI resources available to configure.
module-settings.ai-quotas-rollover-max-explanation: Leave empty to allow unlimited accumulation.
module-settings.ai-quotas-load-error: The quota configuration could not be loaded. Please try again.
module-settings.ai-quotas-invalid-max-amount: Enter a valid maximum amount for {{resource}}.
module-settings.ai-quotas-invalid-custom-days: Enter the number of days per period for {{resource}}.
module-settings.ai-quotas-invalid-rollover-max: Enter a valid maximum accumulated balance for {{resource}}.
module-settings.ai-quotas-limits: Limits by role, school and user
module-settings.ai-quotas-limits-explanation: Every user is already covered by the general limit (if quota control is on), so only add an exception here for a role, a school or a user that needs a different limit. When several exceptions apply to the same user, the most specific one wins: user first, then school, then role, and finally the general limit. Removing or disabling an exception moves that target to the next level that applies to it, not necessarily to the general limit.
module-settings.ai-quotas-limits-disabled-notice: Quota control is off, so these exceptions are not being applied either.
module-settings.ai-quotas-usage-explanation: Users who have consumed AI in the current period, highest first. The table above shows the limits you configured; this one shows who is spending against them, including users covered by a school limit or by the general limit, who never appear as an exception.
module-settings.ai-quotas-usage-none: No usage recorded in the current period yet.
module-settings.ai-quotas-usage-none-filtered: No usage matches the filters applied.
module-settings.ai-quotas-limit-reset-notice: Adding, removing or re-targeting an exception restarts that user's count from zero under the new limit: consumption does not transfer between limits. For example, a user who already spent 90,000 tokens under their school limit and is then given a personal limit of 50,000 gets the full 50,000 for the rest of the period. The complete history is still recorded for auditing.
module-settings.ai-quotas-limit-delete-confirm: Remove this exception? Its target will move to the next limit that applies to it.
module-settings.ai-quotas-limit-missing-resource: Select the resource this exception applies to.
module-settings.ai-quotas-limit-missing-target: Select the role or user this exception applies to.
module-settings.ai-quotas-limit-invalid-days: Enter the number of days per period.
module-settings.ai-quotas-limit-invalid-rollover: Enter a valid maximum accumulated balance.
